Details / Requirements: Strip cargo to the maximum extent as per regulations.

• Prewash is always required.
• Use the minimum quantity of water as per the calculation formula.
• For solidifying cargo, wash immediately after unloading.
• Heat the tank if possible before washing.
• Remove residues from hatches and manholes before prewash if possible.
• For solidifying or highly viscous cargo, use hot water (≥60°C) unless unsuitable.
• Discharge all prewash residue to a shore reception facility.

Wash the tank to commercial standards. Wash water may be discharged into the sea only if:
• Distance from land > 12 nautical miles
• Ship speed > 7 knots
• Water depth > 25 metres
• Using an underwater discharge outlet within the permitted discharge rate.
Any water introduced after commercial cleaning may be discharged into the sea without restrictions.
Strip cargo to the maximum extent as per regulations.
If the cargo is not solidifying or highly viscous, skip the prewash and proceed directly to commercial washing.

If the cargo is solidifying or highly viscous:
• Prewash is mandatory.
• Use the minimum required water.
• Wash immediately after unloading.
• Heat the tank if possible.
• Use hot water (≥60°C) when appropriate.
• Remove residues from hatches/manholes before washing if possible.
• Discharge prewash residue to a shore reception facility.

Wash to commercial standards. Wash water may be discharged into the sea only if:
• Distance from land > 12 nautical miles
• Ship speed > 7 knots
• Water depth > 25 metres
• Using an underwater discharge outlet within the permitted discharge rate.
Any water introduced after commercial cleaning may be discharged into the sea without restrictions.
Strip cargo to the maximum extent as per regulations.

No prewash is required. Wash the tank to commercial standards. Wash water may be discharged into the sea only if:
• Distance from land > 12 nautical miles
• Ship speed > 7 knots
• Water depth > 25 metres
• Underwater discharge outlet required only for ships with keel laid on or after 1 January 2007.
Any water introduced after commercial cleaning may be discharged into the sea without restrictions.
Residues or mixtures containing only Other Substances (OS) are not subject to MARPOL Annex II discharge or tank washing requirements.
